name: auros-web-worker
description: The one Cloudflare Worker behind the Auros order flow. Plain ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types, deliberately: `node --test` then exercises THE CODE THAT SHIPS, with no transpile step in between that could mask a drift between the tested source and the deployed bundle.

scripts.//test: `node --test test/` is NOT the same command as `node --test 'test/*.test.js'` on Node 22: the first resolves `test/` as a MODULE path and dies with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before a single test runs. It was written that way, and nothing ran it, so nobody found out — 233 tests, including the one that asserts this Worker validates with the byte-identical schema auros-recipes uses in CI, were unreachable by their own package script. The glob is load-bearing.
